name: American Bodhi Center
tradition: Chinese Mahayana (Chan/Pure Land) monastic retreat center with a dedicated Insight Meditation retreat program.
technique: Sitting and walking meditation paired with dharma talks and discussion; the Insight Meditation program emphasizes mindfulness of breath and body in the Theravada vipassana style.
influences: Texas Buddhist Association / Jade Buddha Temple
teacherAccess: Retreats and Saturday sittings led by resident monastics (e.g. Ven. Katapunno) together with visiting Insight Meditation teachers from Insight Meditation Houston.
retreatOptions: Residential retreats of flexible length (3-day minimum recommended) in on-site gender-specific dormitories, including multi-day Insight Meditation retreats of up to 7 days.
schedule: Daily schedule of sitting and walking meditation blocks with dharma talk and group discussion; longer retreats include periods of silence.
cost: Roughly $30-$40 per day covering meals and dormitory lodging plus a contribution to the center and teachers; scholarships and hardship exceptions available.

pricePerDay.notes: Approximate daily fee historically quoted at $30-$40/day, covering vegetarian meals and dormitory lodging plus a contribution to the retreat center and teachers; 50% scholarships available for students/financial need, and no one is turned away for financial hardship.

workNotes: No mandatory work period for retreatants; volunteering is invited and especially encouraged for those seeking fee assistance.
foodNotes: Vegetarian meals are served to retreat participants and at center events, following Chinese Mahayana Buddhist dietary practice, and are included in the daily retreat fee.
about: American Bodhi Center is a 515-acre retreat property in Waller County near Hempstead, Texas, run by the Texas Buddhist Association, the Chinese Mahayana (Chan/Pure Land) organization that also operates Jade Buddha Temple in Houston. Opened in 2009, the site includes log houses, gender-specific 40-bed dormitories, a large meditation hall, and dining and library facilities set among rolling hills, streams, and pine forest. Alongside its Chinese Buddhist programs, the center hosts a dedicated Insight Meditation program, including Saturday sittings led by resident monastics and residential retreats of flexible length (a 3-day minimum is recommended) up to 7-day retreats organized with Insight Meditation Houston. Daily fees have historically been in the range of about $30-$40 per day, covering vegetarian meals and dormitory lodging plus a contribution to the retreat center and teachers, with reduced-cost scholarships available and no one turned away for financial hardship. There is no mandatory work period, though volunteering is welcomed, particularly from those seeking fee assistance.
